summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. filed a Form 6-K attaching a July 21, 2026 Arrangement Agreement among BIP Inc., BIP L.P., and Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation (BIPC). The arrangement would consolidate the businesses of BIP and BIPC under newly formed BIP Inc., a British Columbia corporation. BIP's and BIPC's boards, on unanimous special committee recommendations and fairness opinions from Scotia Capital Inc., approved the transaction. Unitholders and shareholders will receive consideration in the new entity. The filing outlines the plan, interim order, meetings, and conditions. Watch for unitholder and shareholder votes and the interim court order to effect the arrangement.
